Western Zhou realm.name: Ji Song
Western Zhou realm.title: King Cheng of Zhou
Western Zhou realm.note: For the first years his uncle the Duke of Zhou (Ji Dan) ruled as regent.
Western Zhou realm.note_zh: 即位初年由叔父周公旦摄政。

Western Zhou realm.name: Ji Hu
Western Zhou realm.title: King Li of Zhou
Western Zhou realm.note: Driven out by a revolt in 841 BCE; died in exile in 828 BCE.
Western Zhou realm.note_zh: 前841年被国人暴动赶走，前828年死于流亡地。

Western Zhou realm.name: Gonghe Regency
Western Zhou realm.title: Gonghe Regency
Western Zhou realm.note: Rule by high ministers (traditionally the Dukes of Zhou and Shao, or Gong He) while the king was in exile. 841 BCE is the first securely dated year in Chinese history.
Western Zhou realm.note_zh: 国王流亡期间由大臣执政（传统说法为周公、召公，或共伯和）。前841年是中国历史上有确切纪年的开始。

sides.name: Zhou and allies
sides.troops_text_zh: 戎车三百乘，虎贲三千人，甲士四万五千人

sides.name: Shang
sides.troops_text: 700,000 (Records of the Grand Historian; surely inflated)

muye.note: Figures are from the Records of the Grand Historian; the Shang number is not believable, and part of the Shang army is said to have turned on its own side.
muye.note_zh: 数字出自《史记》；商军人数不可信，据说部分商军阵前倒戈。
muye.losses: Di Xin burned himself to death; Shang fell

sides.name: Rebels: Three Guards, Wu Geng and Eastern Yi

three-guards-rebellion.losses: Wu Geng and Guanshu killed; Caishu exiled
three-guards-rebellion.losses_zh: 武庚、管叔被杀，蔡叔被流放

king-zhao-southern-campaign.losses: Six royal armies lost; the king drowned in the Han River
king-zhao-southern-campaign.losses_zh: 丧六师于汉，昭王溺死汉水

xianyun-campaign.note: Remembered in the Classic of Poetry and in bronze inscriptions; the Xianyun probably fought from chariots and on foot rather than as true cavalry.
xianyun-campaign.note_zh: 此战见于《诗经》和青铜器铭文；猃狁可能以战车和步兵作战，未必是真正的骑兵。

battle-of-qianmu.losses: The southern royal army was lost

haojing-falls.losses: King You and Duke Huan of Zheng killed; Haojing sacked
haojing-falls.losses_zh: 周幽王与郑桓公被杀，镐京被洗劫

routes.name: King Wu marches on Shang
routes.summary: The Zhou army marched east from Feng-Hao along the Wei and Yellow rivers, crossed at Mengjin, won at Muye and took the Shang capital Chaoge.
routes.summary_zh: 周军从丰镐沿渭河、黄河东进，在孟津渡河，牧野一战获胜后攻入商都朝歌。

routes.name: Duke of Zhou's eastern campaign
routes.summary: The regent led the Zhou army east to crush Wu Geng and the Three Guards, then conquered Yan and Pugu in Shandong.
routes.summary_zh: 周公率军东征，平定武庚与三监之乱，继而攻灭山东的奄和薄姑。

routes.name: King Zhao's southern campaign
routes.summary: King Zhao led his armies south from Chengzhou toward Chu and never came back; he drowned crossing the Han River.
routes.summary_zh: 昭王从成周率军南下征楚，一去不返，渡汉水时溺亡。

routes.name: Driving back the Xianyun
routes.summary: Yin Jifu's chariots drove the Xianyun raiders back north from the Jiaohuo area near the capital; how far north they went is debated.
routes.summary_zh: 尹吉甫率战车把猃狁从镐京附近的焦获一带向北驱逐；追击到何处尚有争议。

people.name: Jizi
people.known_for: A Shang noble who, in tradition, explained the 'Great Plan' of good government to King Wu after the conquest.
people.known_for_zh: 商朝贵族，相传在周灭商后向周武王陈述治国大法《洪范》。

people.name: Duke of Zhou
people.known_for: Regent for young King Cheng who built Luoyi and, in tradition, set out the Zhou rites and music that Confucius admired.
people.known_for_zh: 辅佐年幼的周成王，营建洛邑，相传“制礼作乐”，深受孔子推崇。

people.name: Yin Jifu
people.known_for: Minister of King Xuan, named in the Book of Songs as author of several odes; often called the first named Chinese poet.
people.known_for_zh: 周宣王的大臣，《诗经》中有诗写明为他所作，常被称为中国第一位留名的诗人。
people.line_en: Jifu made this song, gentle as a clear breeze.

people.name: Bo Yangfu
people.known_for: Zhou court official who in 780 BCE explained an earthquake as yin and yang qi falling out of balance, an early yin-yang idea.
people.known_for_zh: 周朝史官，公元前780年用阴阳二气失序解释地震，是早期的阴阳思想。
people.line_zh: 阳伏而不能出，阴迫而不能烝，于是有地震。
people.line_en: When yang is pressed down and cannot rise, and yin presses and cannot steam up, the earth quakes.

people.name: Jiang Ziya
people.known_for: Strategist who commanded Zhou forces at the Battle of Muye and was enfeoffed as the first ruler of Qi.
people.known_for_zh: 辅佐文王武王灭商的军师，封于齐，被尊为兵家之祖。

people.name: Duke of Shao (Shi)
people.known_for: Co-regent with the Duke of Zhou for young King Cheng, founder of the Yan line and governor of the west.
people.known_for_zh: 与周公共同辅政成王，分陕而治，燕国始祖。

people.name: Bo Qin
people.known_for: Eldest son of the Duke of Zhou and first ruler of Lu, who transplanted Zhou rites to the east.
people.known_for_zh: 周公长子，鲁国首位国君，推行周礼于东方。

people.name: King Mu of Zhou
people.known_for: Zhou king celebrated for legendary long journeys to the far west to meet the Queen Mother of the West.
people.known_for_zh: 传说驾八骏西巡，会见西王母。

works.title: Tale of King Mu, Son of Heaven

people.name: Gong He
people.known_for: Led the Gonghe Regency after King Li fled in 841 BC, the first securely dated year in Chinese history.
people.known_for_zh: 国人暴动后主持共和行政，前841年为中国确切纪年之始。

people.name: Feizi of Qin
people.known_for: Horse breeder for King Xiao of Zhou who was granted the fief of Qin, founding the Qin ruling house.
people.known_for_zh: 为周孝王养马有功，受封秦邑，秦国始封之君。

people.name: Zhong Shanfu
people.known_for: Upright chief minister of King Xuan of Zhou, praised in the Book of Odes for restoring royal government.
people.known_for_zh: 周宣王卿士，辅佐宣王中兴，《诗经》有颂。

people.name: Shi Zhou
people.known_for: Grand scribe of King Xuan credited with compiling the earliest Chinese character primer in large seal script.
people.known_for_zh: 周宣王太史，作《史籀篇》，大篆（籀文）之源。

people.name: Duke Huan of Zheng
people.known_for: Minister of the masses under King You who prepared Zheng's eastward move and died defending the king in 771 BC.
people.known_for_zh: 周幽王司徒，谋划郑国东迁，犬戎之乱中殉难。

people.name: Bao Si
people.known_for: Consort of King You of Zhou, linked in legend to the beacon-fire ruse and the fall of Western Zhou.
people.known_for_zh: 周幽王宠妃，烽火戏诸侯传说的主角，西周覆亡相关。

people.name: Weizi Qi
people.known_for: Elder half-brother of King Zhou who left the doomed court and later founded the state of Song.
people.known_for_zh: 纣王庶兄，屡谏不听而去，后受封建立宋国。

capitals.name: Haojing
capitals.note: Main Zhou capital, built by King Wu; sacked by the Quanrong in 771 BCE.
capitals.note_zh: 周武王所建的主要都城，公元前771年被犬戎攻破。

capitals.name: Chengzhou (Luoyi)
capitals.note: Eastern capital built under the Duke of Zhou to control the east; date approximate.
capitals.note_zh: 周公主持营建的东都，用来控制东方，年代为约数。

capitals.name: Qufu
capitals.note: Fief of the Duke of Zhou's family; date of founding approximate.
capitals.note_zh: 周公家族的封国都城，始封年代为约数。

capitals.name: Liulihe
capitals.note: Early Yan capital; bronzes there record the Zhou grant of the fief. Dates approximate.
capitals.note_zh: 早期燕国都城，出土铜器记载了周王封燕之事，年代为约数。

capitals.name: Tang/Jin (Tianma-Qucun)
capitals.note: Early Jin centre with a cemetery of Jin lords; dates approximate.
capitals.note_zh: 早期晋国中心，发现了晋侯墓地，年代为约数。

capitals.name: Linzi
capitals.note: Duke Xian of Qi moved the capital to Linzi.
